name: Super Custom Right Click Menu
author: Jose Varghese

sections.description:
Super Custom Right Click Menu allows you to replace the browser’s default right-click context menu with a custom menu tailored to your website’s needs. This plugin provides an intuitive admin interface to create and manage your custom right-click menu with full customization options.

Key Features

  • Custom Right-Click Menu: Replace the default browser context menu with your own custom menu
  • Drag & Drop Interface: Easily reorder menu items using drag and drop functionality
  • Submenu Support: Create nested submenus for better organization
  • New Tab Option: Choose whether links open in the same tab or a new tab
  • Convert Submenu to Menu: Promote submenu items to main menu items with one click
  • Mobile Control: Option to disable custom menu on mobile/touch devices
  • Full Customization: Customize text color, background color, and font size
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • Touch Support: Long-press support for touch devices (when enabled)
  • Accessibility: Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support
  • Performance Optimized: Lightweight and fast loading

Use Cases

  • Add quick navigation links to important pages
  • Provide shortcuts to contact forms or social media
  • Create custom actions for logged-in users
  • Enhance user experience with contextual options
  • Add branding elements to your website interaction

Easy to Use

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > Right Click Menu
  3. Customize colors and font size
  4. Add your menu items and submenus using drag & drop
  5. Save your settings and enjoy your custom right-click menu!

Developer Friendly

The plugin follows WordPress coding standards and best practices:
* Proper data sanitization and validation
* Secure nonce verification
* Translation ready
* Clean, commented code
* Follows WordPress plugin guidelines
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Login to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Super Custom Right Click Menu”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Login to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Settings > Right Click Menu
  2. Configure your menu colors, font size, and items
  3. Use the drag & drop interface to add and organize menu items
  4. Add submenus by clicking “Add Submenu Item” for any main menu item
  5. Save your settings
sections.faq:
Can I disable the custom menu on mobile devices?

Yes! There’s a “Mobile Settings” option that allows you to disable the custom right-click menu on mobile and touch devices. When enabled, mobile users will see the default browser context menu instead.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes! The plugin includes touch support with long-press functionality for mobile devices. However, you can choose to disable it on mobile devices if you prefer users to have the default browser menu.

Can I add submenus?

Absolutely! Each main menu item can have multiple submenu items that you can add and organize using the drag & drop interface.

Is the plugin accessible?

Yes, the plugin includes full keyboard navigation support and follows accessibility best practices.

Will this affect my website’s performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It only loads the necessary CSS and JavaScript files.

Can I control whether links open in new tabs?

Yes! Each menu item and submenu item has a “New Tab” checkbox that allows you to control whether the link opens in the same tab or a new tab.

Can I convert submenu items to main menu items?

Absolutely! Each submenu item has a “Convert to Menu” button that allows you to promote it to a main menu item with one click.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can customize the text color, background color, and font size of your custom menu through the settings page.

The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. If you experience any issues, please contact support.

Does it work with all themes?

The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. If you experience any issues, please contact support.

Currently, the custom menu appears site-wide. Future versions may include page-specific controls.

Is it translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready and includes proper text domains for all strings.
